theorems.name: Submission.dimred_mbl_lc_rc_push_add
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (O : Set (Euclid P)) (push : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n → GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (X Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), (∀ X₁ X₂ : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, IsIntegerMultiplicity X₁ → IsIntegerMultiplicity X₂ → IsCompact X₁.support → X₁.support ⊆ O → IsCompact X₂.support → X₂.support ⊆ O → push (X₁ - X₂) = push X₁ - push X₂) → IsIntegerMultiplicity X → IsIntegerMultiplicity Y → IsCompact X.support → X.support ⊆ O → IsCompact Y.support → Y.support ⊆ O → ∃ S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, IsIntegerMultiplicity S ∧ (∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, S ω = X ω + Y ω) ∧ S.support ⊆ X.support ∪ Y.support ∧ IsCompact S.support ∧ ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n, push S ω = push X ω + push Y ω
